results.text: Long-term safety and efficacy comparison of immediate-release and sustained-release oral verapamil in systemic hypertension. The long-term safety and efficacy of twice-daily sustained-release verapamil were assessed compared to thrice-daily immediate-release verapamil in 25 patients with mild to moderate systemic hypertension. Solriamfetol is a selective dopamine and noradrenalin reuptake inhibitor applied in adult patients with excessive daytime sleepiness (EDS) associated with narcolepsy or obstructive sleep apnea (OSA).
